
```{r load-raw}
# Read and save data
sc <- fread( "./SS2_counts.csv", header=T  )
pd <- fread( "./SS2_pheno.csv", header=T  )

```

## from github

https://github.com/vhowick/MalariaCellAtlas/tree/v1.0/Expression_Matrices/Smartseq2

ShortenedLifeStage: The experimental groups of cells including
bbSpz (bite back/ injected sporozoite)     
EEF (Liver stage)
Merozoite    
oocyst (day 4 oocysts)     
ook (Bolus ookinetes at 18 and 24 hrs)   
ookoo (48 hr ookinetes and oocysts from midgut tissue)   
Ring (Ring culture)
sgSpz (salivary gland Sporozoites)  
Shz (Late stage culture, includes male, female, trophozoites and schizonts)

ShortenedLifeStage2: same as ShortenedLifeStage but with blood stage classifications from SC3 so Shz is split into Male, Female, Trophozoite, Schizont

ShortenedLifeStage3: same as ShortendLifeStage2 but with ookoo split into Ookinete and Oocyst

ShortendLifeStage4: same as ShortendLifeStage3 but with bbSpz and sgSpz combined to just Spz

Colors in fig1 based on ShortendLifeStage2


```{r load-raw}
grp <- pd$ShortenedLifeStage2
grp <- factor( grp, levels=c( "EEF", "Ring",  "Trophozoite",  "Schizont", "Merozoite", "Male", "Female","ook", "ookoo", "oocyst", "sgSpz","bbSpz"  ) )
mat <- as.matrix( sc[,-1] )
rownames(mat) <- sc$V1
tj <- colSums( mat ); stopifnot( all(tj>0) )
tj <- tj/exp(mean(log(tj)))
.pd <- data.frame(
  tj=tj, 
  logtj=log(tj),
  group=grp
)
rownames(.pd) <- colnames(mat)

#rownames(mat) were used with plasmodb to extract annotations
fd_plasmodb <- read.csv(file= "./fdata_plasmodb.txt", header=1, sep="\t")
fd_plasmodb <- fd_plasmodb[ match( rownames(mat), fd_plasmodb$Input.ID ), ]
rownames(fd_plasmodb) <- rownames(mat)

#there are many genes for which we don't have names. For these, we shift to feature ids. 
nai <- which(fd_plasmodb$Gene.Name.or.Symbol == "N/A")
fd_plasmodb$Gene.Name.or.Symbol[ nai ] <- fd_plasmodb$Input.ID[nai]


es <- ExpressionSet( assayData = mat, 
                     phenoData = AnnotatedDataFrame( .pd ), 
                     featureData = AnnotatedDataFrame( fd_plasmodb)
                     )
es$group <- factor( es$group, levels=levels(grp) )

fdata <- fData(es)
Y_raw <- exprs(es)
xdata <- pData(es)
zdata <- xdata

# -- enrichment set
library(tidyverse)
library(GO.db)
df_clean <- fdata %>%
  dplyr::select(Input.ID, Curated.GO.Processes) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(Curated.GO.Processes)) %>%
  filter(Curated.GO.Processes != "" & Curated.GO.Processes != "NA" & Curated.GO.Processes != "N/A") %>%
  separate_rows(Curated.GO.Processes, sep = ";") %>%
  mutate(Curated.GO.Processes = trimws(Curated.GO.Processes)) %>%
  filter(Curated.GO.Processes != "")
go_mapping <- Term(GOTERM) 
df_clean$GO_Description <- go_mapping[df_clean$Curated.GO.Processes]
df_clean <- df_clean %>%
  mutate(GO_Description = ifelse(is.na(GO_Description), Curated.GO.Processes, GO_Description))
enrichment_list <- split(df_clean$Input.ID, df_clean$GO_Description)
enrichment_list <- enrichment_list[ sapply( enrichment_list, length) >= 5 ]
```

# Define SVDX formulas
```{r formulas}
xformula = ~group 
zformula = ~1

set.seed(1)
train_samples <- unlist( lapply(unique(xdata$group), function(g){
  gsi <- which( xdata$group == g )
  sample(gsi, .7*length(gsi))
  }) )
```

# Optional inputs
```{r optional-inputs}
row_offsets <- rep(0, nrow(es))
col_offsets <- rep(0, ncol(es))
tj <- colSums( exprs(es) ); tj <- tj/exp(mean(log(tj)))

```

# Preprocess

```{r preprocess}

fdata <- as_svdx_fdata(
  fdata,
  feature_col = "Input.ID", #these are the rownames in the circ data
  label_col = "Gene.Name.or.Symbol", #these are what we will use for labeling features in plots
  enrichment_col = "Input.ID" #these are what we will use for enrichment when we do inferecne
)

prepared <- svdx:::prepare_svdx_data(
  Y = Y_raw,
  xdata = xdata,
  zdata = zdata,
  xformula = xformula,
  zformula = zformula,
  fdata = fdata,
  family = NULL, 
  log1p_transform = TRUE,              #already transformed      
  t_j = tj,
  normalize = TRUE,                    #data has already been normalization
  top_ftrs = 5000,
  center_rows = TRUE,    
  scale_rows = TRUE,
  allow_sparse_densification = TRUE,
  col_offset = col_offsets,
  row_offset = row_offsets,
  dataset_name = "malaria_berghei"
)
```


Run 
```{r}

#benchmark
METHODS <- c(
  "svdx",
  "pca",
  ##"mefisto_duplicate_view", #no mefisto as only categorical covarates here
  "nmf",
  "mixomics_pls",
  "spca",
  "sparse_nmf"
)
SPCA_KEEPX_GRID <- round(c(0.01, 0.25, 0.5) * nrow(prepared$Y))
SPARSE_NMF_LAMBDA_GRID <- 10^c(-3, -2, -1)
rw_single <- run_real_world_single_benchmark(
  
  Y = prepared$Y,
  data = prepared$xdata,
  xformula = prepared$xformula,
  zdata = prepared$zdata,
  zformula = prepared$zformula,
  train_cols = train_samples,
  fdata = fdata, 
  
  K = 15, #max number of distinct groups here

  methods = METHODS,
  inference_methods = c("svdx"), ftol_abs = 1e-5, xtol_abs=1e-3, fitter_maxIter = 1000, 
  
  run_factorization = TRUE,
  run_inference = TRUE,
  
  inference_scope = "all",
  feature_sets = enrichment_list, 
  
  nfolds = 10 #svdx folds , we have good amount of data
  
)


#output
rw <- runSingleBenchmarkReports(rw_single = rw_single, 
                                    outdir = "./malaria_berghei_nfolds10", overwrite=T, 
                                 color="group", group="group", line_group = "group",
                                xaxis="group", 
                                 loading_enrichment = T, 
                                    enrichment_top_n = 25, 
                                svdx_report_args = list( z_adjustment = "fitted", 
                                                         heatmap_order_by = c("group"), 
                                                         feature_profile_show_se = T , 
                                                         feature_profile_color = "group", 
                                                         feature_profiles_top_n = 5L,
                                                         x ="group"
                                                         )
                                 )


```
